headlines.headline: JUDGE GRANTS ELIGIBILITY TROs AS CONFERENCES CRACK DOWN ON FORMER PROS IN COLLEGE HOOPS
headlines.detail: A Dallas judge issued temporary restraining orders preserving eligibility for players including CJ Gunn, Rylan Griffen, and Riley Kugel, while the ACC and Mountain West adopted new policies barring former professionals from returning to college sports.

headlines.headline: TRAIL BLAZERS ACQUIRE JA MORANT FROM GRIZZLIES IN OFFSEASON BLOCKBUSTER
headlines.detail: Portland added former All-Star point guard Ja Morant in a trade with Memphis, one of the bigger moves of an active NBA offseason.

headlines.headline: NFL TEAMS RACE TO TRIM ROSTERS TO 53 BEFORE SUNDAY'S DEADLINE
headlines.detail: All 32 teams must cut from 90 to 53 players by Sunday, Aug. 30, a leaguewide purge of roughly 1,184 players following Thursday's final preseason games.

headlines.headline: FBS SEASON KICKS OFF SATURDAY, HEADLINED BY NORTH CAROLINA-TCU IN DUBLIN
headlines.detail: The 2026 FBS season opens Saturday with North Carolina vs. TCU in Dublin, Ireland, alongside San Jose State at USC and NC State at Virginia.
